title: Casting simulation and porosity prediction
short: Calibrating MAGMASOFT casting simulations against physical die-casting results so that predicted porosity and fluidity can be trusted, and fewer physical trials are needed.
lede: Casting simulation is cheap but low fidelity; CT scanning of cast parts is high fidelity but expensive. This research ties the two together. Ongoing.
org: Advanced Casting Research Center, The Ohio State University
ownership: My role is the simulation side of the workflow below: calibrating MAGMASOFT against experimental results, building and modifying mold CAD, and configuring and running the cases. I also collect and analyze die-casting data that supports calibrating the machine-learning defect models, which are broader research efforts.

sections.heading: Problem and background
paras: MAGMASOFT predictions must be calibrated against physical die-casting results before the simulated porosity and fluidity behavior can be trusted. Without calibration, a simulation can look convincing and still disagree with the part that comes out of the die.

sections.heading: Objective
paras: Develop a simulation and data workflow that:
bullets: Correlates MAGMASOFT results with experimental casting data to validate simulation settings.
Evaluates porosity and fluidity across multiple casting conditions.
Reduces reliance on physical casting trials.

sections.heading: Where my work sits
paras: The research group's workflow starts from process parameters: metal temperature, mold temperature, shot profile, composition, and vacuum level. Those drive both die-casting trials and casting simulations. Simulation results are low fidelity and cheap; CT scanning of cast parts is high fidelity and expensive. Bayesian optimization with a surrogate model links the two, and AI/ML models (random forest, neural network, logistic regression) predict porosity. My work is the casting-simulation block.

sections.heading: Approach and responsibilities
bullets: Calibrate MAGMASOFT simulations against experimental results and troubleshoot discrepancies with real-world casting behavior.
Build and modify CAD models of molds and internal mold features.
Configure and execute simulations for gravity casting and high-pressure die casting (HPDC).
Collect and analyze experimental die-casting data to validate simulations and calibrate machine-learning models for casting defect prediction.
Prepare metal samples for electron microscopy and tensile testing to characterize material and casting performance.

sections.heading: Progress and results
bullets: Generated 30+ metal-casting simulations across multiple material conditions.
Debugged material-property and database issues for 13+ material systems.
Calibration and validation against experimental results are ongoing, so there is no final result to report yet.
